title: Generate an LLM-ready prompt for cell-type annotation — typoPrompt
text: typoPrompt() provides model- provider-independent workflow LLM-assisted cell annotation. Unlike ceLLMarkup, connect LLM directly therefore requires API key, model configuration, local LLM server. Instead, prepares annotation task submission user's preferred chatbot LLM. generated prompt includes: positive markers , optionally, negative markers set; available sample, tissue, condition, species, feature context; instructions consider complete marker profile rather   individual markers; instructions distinguish cell types, subtypes, cellular   states supported marker evidence; request top_k ranked annotations confidence   scores concise biological rationales; standardized Markdown-table response format followed overall   interpretation. ClustoCell objects containing major clusters sub-clusters, prompt additionally describes hierarchy asks LLM first establish identity parent cluster interpret sub-clusters biologically meaningful subtypes states within context. Printing returned TypoPrompt object displays formatted HTML interface: underlying plain-text prompt remains directly accessible cat(prompt) .character(prompt). can also saved programmatically using saveTypoPrompt format = "txt" format = "html". Interactive HTML rendering HTML export require optional htmltools package; unavailable, printing falls back plain-text prompt.
